1879060878.name: Improved Song of Aid
1879060878.desc:
Inspires Fellows to perform heroic feats, and the effects last longer and recover more quickly.

Burglar: Gains a Critical Response.

Captain: Gains an Enemy Defeat Response.

Champion: Gains an Enemy Defeat Response.

Guardian: Gains a Block Response and a Parry Response.

Hunter: Gains a Parry Response.

Lore-master: Beacon of Hope has a decreased Cooldown and Morale cost.

Minstrel: Unlocks Bolster Courage for free and Dissonance Calls.

Rune-keeper: Scribe's Spark and Prelude to Hope have decreased Cooldowns.

Warden: Shield Piercer has a decreased Cooldown.

1879064078.name: Hamstring
1879064078.desc: Makes an attack which snares your opponent.

1879064206.name: Song of Distraction
1879064206.desc: A song that can make your enemy become drowsy and not detect players until they are much closer than normal. This does not work against monsters already engaged in combat.

1879064334.name: Addle
1879064334.desc: Cause the enemy to fail skill attempts, and subsequent skill attempts will briefly take longer to execute.

1879073678.name: Blinding Dust
1879073678.desc: You throw dust into the air around, blinding nearby foes.

1879091726.name: Kick
1879091726.desc: A melee attack that interrupts enemy inductions.

1879097230.name: Turtle-speech
1879097230.desc: Summons a little turtle-friend to brighten your day.

1879108878.name: Shield-bash
1879108878.desc: A quick strike with a shield.

1879111438.name: Blood Rage
1879111438.desc: Breaks Champion out of any impairing Combat State and removes disarm effects.

1879132046.name: Muster in Evendim
1879132046.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Tinnudir in Evendim.

1879186702.name: Dazing Blow
1879186702.desc: Dazes the enemy with a pair of melee attacks while dual-wielding.

1879198350.name: Friend of Large Hunters (Grey Sabre-cat)
1879198350.desc: Summons a sabre-tooth cat companion.\n\nThe sabre-tooth cat hails from the north and can wield the cold of its home.

1879208718.name: Vile Vittles
1879208718.desc: Nothing about these vittles looks right, but you're probably going to try them anyways.\n\nLiver, don't fail me now!

1879214606.name: War-cry
1879214606.desc: A shout which deals Light Damage to a group of enemies around the Warden.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879241998.name: Driving Slash
1879241998.desc: Using a violent slash against the target you attempt to seriously injure your foe.

1879243918.name: Improved Hampering Javelin of Light
1879243918.desc: A precise throw can pin a target to the ground and hinder its movement for a short while thereafter.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>Mounted Combat Enemies: Root replaced with a mount acceleration debuff</rgb>

1879251342.name: Guide to Snowbourn
1879251342.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Snowbourn in eastern Rohan.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879301902.name: Improved Standard of Honour
1879301902.desc: Calls forth the Standard of Honour, dealing damage to enemies while healing the Morale of nearby allies.

1879307150.name: Large Shrew
1879307150.desc: Summons a large shrew to brighten your day.

1879315086.name: Guarded Attack
1879315086.desc: Calculated and precise, your attacks hit their mark while bolstering your defences against any retaliation.\n\nThe mitigation buff stacks up to 5 times.

1879321614.name: Faltharan's Steed
1879321614.desc: A horse from the defenders of Pelargir.

1879332622.name: Miniature Grodbog Warrior
1879332622.desc: Summons a small grodbog warrior to keep you company.

1879344398.name: Yule Festival Pony
1879344398.desc: A pony from the Yule Festival.

1879366926.name: Goat of Erebor's Royal Guard
1879366926.desc: A goat clad in the raiment of Erebor's royal guard.

1879392270.name: Steed of the Dead City
1879392270.desc: A steed clad in Morgul raiment.

1879408142.name: Red Firefly
1879408142.desc: Summons a red firefly to keep you company.

1879409166.name: White Goose
1879409166.desc: Summons a white goose to keep you company.

1879411086.name: Burgundy Goat
1879411086.desc: A little goat who would like to see the world with you.

1879416078.name: Return to Trader's Wharf
1879416078.desc: You're able to quickly return to Trader's Wharf. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879416846.name: Wild Trestlebridge Steed
1879416846.desc: A wild steed of the Wildwood.

1879421838.name: Return to Glân Vraig
1879421838.desc: A map detailing the lay of the land leading to Glân Vraig

1879455630.name: Flashing Blades
1879455630.desc: After using Double-edged Strike, make a pair of powerful attacks against a single enemy.\n\n<rgb=#FFFF00> Dual-wielding required.</rgb>

1879457550.name: Ranged Unseen Strikes
1879457550.desc:
A series of impossibly fast attacks strike your opponents.

This skill will consume any War Cry, Brink of Victory, Surety of Death, or Desolation damage over time effects on your targets, dealing bonus damage for each effect consumed.

<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879465486.name: Homesteader's Draught Horse
1879465486.desc: Summons a strong draught horse to work your homestead and accompany you on your journeys.

1879466254.name: Sail to the Mirk-eaves
1879466254.desc: Navigate to the Mirk-eaves with nearby fellows.

1879486478.name: Parrot of Light
1879486478.desc: Summons a frosty-white parrot to accompany you on your travels.

1879488014.name: Dispel Corruption
1879488014.desc: Removes a Corruption from multiple foes.

1879489166.name: Cornered Vigour
1879489166.desc: Your companion is an accomplished hunter, and can push through pain. They will restore some Morale every time they are struck by an enemy.

1879506830.name: Renewed Strength
1879506830.desc: Energize and rally your allies while crushing nearby enemies.
